'''Praaelon Di''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]]-allied arms dealer. He provided weapons to both sides of an uprising on a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony on [[Weldii III]], causing the facility's [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]], [[Lenc]], to put a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on his head. With a number of Rebel agents and [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] at his side, Di clashed with a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] fleet and a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], led by [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]], before traveling to Weldii III and taking the fight to Lenc there.
